metrics.scope: Positive/duplicate/unresolved-parent identity probes and actual pinned StrictDoc parsing. Missing-tool, parser error, input-growth and process-timeout paths are not injected.

limitations: Mapped source-line and per-line maximum branch counts; not complete path coverage.
Owned client Coverlet metrics are separate; native executable and vendor internals are excluded.
PowerShell subprocess command/branch metrics, full native installers, Linux helper paths and vendor internals are unmeasured.
Synthetic supervisor/publication fixtures do not qualify numerical simulator execution.
executed_command_sequence: dotnet run --file scripts/ValidateRequirements.cs -- --python <configured StrictDoc Python> --report evidence/final-435-strictdoc.json
collection: Both commands executed under one dotnet-coverage 18.12 process/subprocess session, direct Cobertura output. The local PowerShell driver only serializes those invocations.
